aboutWhoP: GRAND VIEW CERAMIC AND MARBLE WORK is based in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Our brand is built around a simple idea: the small details make a meaningful difference to how a space looks and works.
aboutWhoP2: We aim to begin each project with a clear understanding of the clients expectations, site conditions and practical constraints. From there, careful preparation and good communication help guide the work through to completion.
aboutWhoP3: We welcome enquiries for tile and marble work, along with plumbing, pipe fitting and electrical service requirements. The exact scope is confirmed case by case.

homeFaqP: Practical answers regarding project scope, quotes, and on-site delivery in Abu Dhabi.
homeFaq1Q: What types of properties do you service in Abu Dhabi?
homeFaq1A: We handle residential villas, apartments, majlis renovations, and light commercial spaces across Abu Dhabi. Contact us with your area to confirm site access.
homeFaq2Q: How do you provide an accurate estimate?
homeFaq2A: We begin with your approximate dimensions, photos, or architectural drawings via WhatsApp. Final quotations are confirmed following site inspection and material review.
homeFaq3Q: Can you handle plumbing and electrical adjustments during tiling?
homeFaq3A: Yes, we coordinate pipe fittings, drainage alignment, and electrical fixture adjustments to ensure a cohesive and tidy handover.
